## Cancellation Policy Overview

The following cancellation rules apply to all bookings (flights, hotels, and car rentals) made through State Travel:

### 1. Flights

| Timeframe | Refund | Fee |
|---|---|---|
| More than 24 hours before departure | Full refund | No fee |
| Within 24 hours of departure | Partial refund (varies by fare class) | Cancellation fee applies |
| After departure (no-show) | No refund | Full fare forfeited |

- **Refundable tickets:** Can be cancelled at any time for a full refund minus any applicable service fees.
- **Non-refundable tickets:** Cancellation results in a travel credit (minus cancellation fee) valid for 12 months.

### 2. Hotels

| Timeframe | Refund | Fee |
|---|---|---|
| More than 48 hours before check-in | Full refund | No fee |
| 24–48 hours before check-in | Partial refund | One-night charge |
| Less than 24 hours / no-show | No refund | Full stay charged |

- **Free cancellation bookings:** As indicated at time of reservation; typically 48+ hours before check-in.
- **Non-refundable rate bookings:** No refund upon cancellation.

### 3. Car Rentals

| Timeframe | Refund | Fee |
|---|---|---|
| More than 24 hours before pick-up | Full refund | No fee |
| Within 24 hours of pick-up | Partial refund | Service fee applies |
| No-show | No refund | Full rental charged |

### 4. Bundled / Package Bookings

- Cancellation of one component may affect the pricing of remaining components.
- Package discount may be recalculated if a component is removed.
- Full package cancellation follows the most restrictive component policy.

---

2. **Refunds** are processed to the original payment method within 7–10 business days.
3. **Travel credits** (where applicable) are non-transferable and expire 12 months from the date of issue.
4. **Travel insurance** claims are handled separately and may provide additional coverage beyond the standard policy.
5. **Force majeure / extraordinary circumstances** (e.g., natural disasters, government travel bans) may qualify for full refund exceptions at management discretion.

---

*This document is for internal Executive Team reference. Policy details are subject to change; always verify against the latest policy version in the booking system.*
